reason: The cited evidence (E1) discusses CoCrNi MEAs, not AlCrFeNiSi, and only generally states that LAM enables high cooling rates yielding refined microstructures, without providing specific support for the claimed mechanisms linking high scanning speed to reduced segregation, residual stress, and improved mechanical properties in the target alloy.
premises: High scanning speed LPBF increases cooling rate during solidification
Increased cooling rate limits diffusion-driven elemental segregation
Increased cooling rate minimizes thermal gradients that cause residual stress and defects
Refined, homogeneous microstructure improves mechanical integrity
These mechanisms apply to cobalt-free AlCrFeNiSi
